title: idempotency response missing accountId field
description: In peer_deliver, when a retransmitted sender_msg_id is detected (idempotency path, lines 260-265), the returned JSON is { accepted, id, receivedAt } — missing accountId. The successful first-delivery response includes accountId: 'a-self'. Any client code that pattern-matches on the full response shape will see an inconsistent structure on retransmit. The JMAP spec expects consistent response shapes across the same method.
